units.source_text: “已故的小岸说过，他想早日成为先生这样的人，每晚歇息之前，在被褥上静坐片刻。

en.t: The late Kogishi once said that he wanted to become someone like you as soon as possible, and that every night before going to sleep he would sit quietly for a while on his bedding.

units.source_text: 那时节，流行冈田式静坐法哩。”

en.t: At that time, the Okada-style method of quiet sitting was in fashion.
